fields.name: region
fields.description: Market region code. Options: US (United States), GB (United Kingdom), MX (Mexico), ES (Spain), ID (Indonesia), VN (Vietnam), MY (Malaysia), TH (Thailand), PH (Philippines)

fields.name: dateInfo
fields.description: Date specification object, containing type and value fields

fields.name: dateInfo.value
fields.description: Date value: day format YYYY-MM-DD, week format YYYY-weekNumber (e.g., 2025-18), month format YYYY-MM

fields.name: category
fields.description: Product category name (English), matched to TikTok category ID. Non-English input must be translated to English first

fields.name: orderby
fields.description: Sort rule object, containing field and order fields

fields.name: orderby.field
fields.description: Sort field: units_sold (sales), gmv (GMV), total_units_sold (total sales), total_gmv (total GMV), growth_rate (growth rate)

fields.name: orderby.order
fields.description: Sort direction: desc (descending), asc (ascending), default desc
